| Manuscript claim | Source | Use |
|---|---|---|

| “Structure” can generate hierarchy and triviality problems | van Fraassen 2006; Roberts 2011 | Ontology restraint |
| Gauge reduction and sophisticated symmetry treatments differ | Belot 2003; Dewar 2019 | Gauge taxonomy |
| Surplus gauge structure can be required for rich local fields | Nguyen, Teh, Wells 2020 | Locality-loss example |
| Formal equivalence alone need not settle interpretation | Coffey 2014 | Semantics/equivalence distinction |
| Weak algebraic equivalence may fail as physical equivalence | Lupher 2018 | Property-relative identity |
| Exact duality is an isomorphism of model roots in a domain | De Haro, Butterfield 2018 | Duality versus approximation |
| RG methods have domain-specific variants and interpretations | Koberinski, Fraser 2023 | Scale-transformation qualification |
| Infinite idealization challenges selective realism about EFTs | Rivat 2021 | Limit epistemology |
| Representations can be constrained by physical perspicuity | North 2026 | Closest recent representation account |
| Locally covariant QFT is functorial, yet sameness needs more structure | BFV 2003; Fewster 2015 | Categorical comparison |
| Relational quantum mechanics relativizes facts between systems | Rovelli 1996 | Distinction from this framework |
| OS axioms reconstruct a Hilbert-space quantum theory from Euclidean data | Osterwalder--Schrader 1973, 1975 | Reconstruction interface |
| RG reorganizes scale dependence | Wilson, Kogut 1974 | Technical physics baseline |

priority claims from these sources.
